sourceRefs.locator: Personal recollection beginning Quem condigne laudare; trilingual writing in Et haec omnia; seven years, expulsion, reception under Constantius and crossing of the Danube in Ubi et post multorum.
Opening section Wulfila, excerpt of Philostorgius, Ecclesiastical History 2.5 in Photius’ epitome, followed by the conditional calculation of 347–348.
Chapter 1, discussion immediately before §1.5 and §1.5 on the division of translation work and the codices; §2.1, table 2.1, on letter shapes, order and numeral values.

summary.de: Bischof des vierten Jahrhunderts. Sein Schüler Auxentius kannte ihn als Lehrer und dreisprachigen Prediger. Kirchenhistoriker führen das gotische Alphabet und die Bibelübersetzung auf ihn zurück.
summary.en: A fourth-century bishop. His pupil Auxentius knew him as a teacher and trilingual preacher. Church historians credit him with the Gothic alphabet and biblical translation.
